SLAY_THE_SPIRE2_MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_FORTE.de: Improves the effects of Attack, Skill, and Power Notes.
SLAY_THE_SPIRE2_MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_PHRASE_S: Triggers when the Note rack is empty.
SLAY_THE_SPIRE2_MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_PHRASE_E: Triggers when exactly one Note slot is empty.
SLAY_THE_SPIRE2_MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_PERFORMA: Played at the start of the next several turns.
SLAY_THE_SPIRE2_MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_STARRY.d: Playing this card generates a Starry Note, which grants {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} when triggered.
SLAY_THE_SPIRE2_MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_BASIC_NO: Attack, Skill, Power, Status, and Curse Notes correspond to the five basic card types.
SLAY_THE_SPIRE2_MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_ATTACK_N: Deals 2 damage to a random enemy when triggered, increased by 2 per Forte.
SLAY_THE_SPIRE2_MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_SKILL_NO: Grants 1 Block when triggered, increased by 1 per Forte.
SLAY_THE_SPIRE2_MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_POWER_NO: Draw 1 card, increased by 1 per 2 Forte.
SLAY_THE_SPIRE2_MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_STATUS_N: Apply 1 Weak and Vulnerable to all enemies. Unaffected by Forte.
SLAY_THE_SPIRE2_MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_CURSE_NO: Heals 2 HP when triggered and is unaffected by Forte.
SLAY_THE_SPIRE2_MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_GHOST_NO: Grants 1 Buffer when triggered and is unaffected by Forte.
SLAY_THE_SPIRE2_MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_CHORD.de: When all Note slots are filled, resolves every slotted Note in order and empties the rack.
SLAY_THE_SPIRE2_MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_OMNIA_NO: Has the effects of all 5 Basic Notes and the Starry Note.
